Final for Publication

Zoning App. No. 22716

17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 4525-B N. Delphia, Chicago, IL
Proposed Zoning: RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District

Lot Area: 15,000 square feet

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is seeking a zoning change to permit the construction of a
new two-story single-family home with an attached garage with three (3)
parking spaces. The proposed building will measure 29 feet-11 inches in
height.

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 4,517.9 square feet (0.301 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 15,000 square feet per D.U.
(1 residential unit)

(C) The amount of off-street parking: 3 parking spaces

(D) Setbacks:
a. Front (west) Setback: 25 feet
b. Side Setbacks:
North Side: 10 feet
South Side: 10 feet
c. Rear (east) Setback: 42 feet

(E) Building Height: 29 feet-11 inches

* As part of this Type 1 Application, the Applicant is seeking all zoning relief required to permit
the attached Plan Set.
